# Dispatch T3 — configured-link reconciliation and envelope vocabulary (engineer)

Feature snapshot-recovery, revision r30. T1+T2 done. Scope: ONLY the eight T3 files. No other edits, no external research, no network.

## Files (your only write set)
- internal/storage/recovery.go
- internal/storage/recovery_test.go
- internal/observe/envelope.go
- internal/observe/log.go
- internal/observe/log_test.go
- internal/observe/edge_test.go
- docs/logging-contract.md
- cmd/mcp-bridge/config_envelope_test.go

## Read first
- .scratch/snapshot-recovery/spec.md: T3 objective, R2/R4/R6/R8, D6/D8/D9/D12, AC2-9 and AC1-10 subcase list; current recovery.go from T1/T2 and envelope/log anchors cited there.

## Required work
1. Pre-pass chain records and moved-entry set keyed by original configured path plus pre-move entry identity; partner-versus-self from recorded chain-entry paths, never bare inode.
2. Ordinary run-orphaned (r20 C7/D12) and mutual loop-partner (r23 C5, detections m-i..m-iv) reconciliations, gated on a live post-pass symlink entry and the moved-entry set; own-family reserve+rename preserving link bytes; Reason=orphaned_link; deterministic record order; R3-fatal discipline; post-reconciliation retention.
3. R8 envelope vocabulary: add event-specific fields needed (e.g. quarantine_path) to addEnvelopeFields/runtimeErrorInfo while keeping validErrorInfo exact-equality admission; preserve schema_version and all existing fields; update docs/logging-contract.md tables.
4. Tests: orphaned link, mutual pair, mutual hardlinked CT24-C5 variant, both-moved zero-reconciliation, seeded mutual-class retention; AC1-10 (b-xA)/(b-xB)/(b-xA2)/(b-xB2)/(b-xB3)/(b-xB-res)/(b-dangle) fixtures; pin the non-mutual originally-dangling OPEN carve-out as a limitation (do not falsely pass); log union literal update; config envelope pin; edge admission cases.

## Verify (report exact commands+outputs)
1. go build ./...
2. go test ./internal/storage/... -count=1
3. go test ./internal/observe/... -count=1
4. go test ./cmd/mcp-bridge/ -run TestEnvelopeFieldNames|TestSnapshotRecoveryOrphanedLink|TestSnapshotRecoveryMutualLink|TestSnapshotRecoveryMutualBothMoved|TestSnapshotRecoveryMutualHardlinked|TestSnapshotRecoveryNonMutualDangling -count=1
End with INCOMPLETE and the exact blocker if any required behavior cannot be implemented inside this file set.
